description: Scrape Amazon's Best Sellers, New Releases, Most Wished For, Most Gifted, or Movers & Shakers charts for one or more categories.

categoryNodeIds.description: Amazon browse-node IDs in `rootSlug/nodeId` form (e.g. `electronics/172541` for Headphones). Combined with `categoryUrls` if both are provided.
categoryNodeIds.title: Category node IDs

categoryUrls.description: Amazon category slugs (e.g. `electronics`, `electronics/172541`) or full chart URLs to scrape. A full chart URL supplies its own chart type and marketplace, e.g. `https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/new-releases/electronics`.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or slugs

chartType.description: Which Amazon chart to scrape. A full chart URL pasted into `categoryUrls` overrides this with the URL's own chart type.
chartType.title: Chart type

domain.description: Which Amazon marketplace to scrape the chart from. A full chart URL pasted into `categoryUrls` overrides this with the URL's own marketplace.
domain.title: Amazon domain

includeProductDetails.description: For each chart item, also fetch its product detail page for list-price and in-stock data. Slower and bounded by `maxProductDetails`.
includeProductDetails.title: Enrich with product detail page

maxDepth.description: When > 0, also walk each category's left-nav subcategory links this many levels deep, scraping each subcategory's own chart too. 0 = only the given categories.
maxDepth.title: Subcategory recursion depth

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total chart items emitted across all categories in this run.
maxItems.title: Max total items

maxItemsPerCategory.description: Hard cap on chart items emitted per category (across all its pages). Maximum 100; coverage fields still report the full listed-rank range.
maxItemsPerCategory.title: Max items per category

maxMissingDetailFetches.description: Per-category cap on best-effort product-page fetches used to fill ranks the nextPage response did not cover. Set 0 to disable product-page fill.
maxMissingDetailFetches.title: Max missing-detail product fetches

maxPages.description: Maximum number of chart pages to fetch per category, starting at `startPage`. Capped at 2 (top 100).
maxPages.title: Max pages per category

maxProductDetails.description: Hard cap on how many chart items get product-detail enrichment when `includeProductDetails` is on.
maxProductDetails.title: Max product detail fetches

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used to fetch chart pages. Datacenter (AUTO) is used by default and works for most requests; the actor escalates to residential only after repeated blocks on a session.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

startPage.description: First chart page to fetch (1 or 2). Pages are capped at 2 so a chart never exceeds the real top-100 boundary.
startPage.title: Start page

title: Amazon Best Sellers & Rankings Scraper Input
